principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages both item properties and payment status, leading to multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment-related methods (like setting the order status) into another class or utilize events to update the status.

principle_violations.reason: Adding further payment processors would require modifying the implementation, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a new interface for payment processors tailored for extension, for example, by utilizing strategy or composition.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
